pubmed_and_europepmc.query: (melatonin OR "prolonged-release melatonin") AND (insomnia OR "sleep onset latency" OR "sleep latency") AND ("meta-analysis" OR "systematic review")

search_log.web_search: meta-analysis melatonin primary insomnia randomized placebo sleep onset latency minutes
search_log.screening: titles screened for meta-analyses / systematic reviews of the topic's drug and outcome; off-topic hits not listed
search_log.assessment: C1 computed mechanically (Europe PMC OA flag + licence, Unpaywall licence); C2-C6 judged per candidate from its own text (full text for on-topic C1-PASS candidates, abstract otherwise) with verbatim evidence; LEAD-verified entries say so. No information about our own pool was used.
